# MatchLiveNow

> Find every TV channel and streaming service to watch the FIFA World Cup 2026 — live, free and paid options for every country.

MatchLiveNow (MLN) is a bilingual (English / Spanish) guide that helps fans discover where to watch every FIFA World Cup 2026 match in their country. Each match page lists official broadcasters, free-to-air channels, and streaming platforms with affiliate links per country.

## Pages

- [Home (English)](/en): Live scores, fixtures and World Cup 2026 broadcasters worldwide.
- [Home (Spanish)](/es): Marcadores en vivo, calendario y canales del Mundial 2026.
- [Privacy Policy (EN)](/en/privacy-policy): How we handle data.
- [Privacy Policy (ES)](/es/privacy-policy): Política de privacidad.
- [Terms (EN)](/en/terms): Terms of service.
- [Terms (ES)](/es/terms): Términos del servicio.
- [Responsible Gambling (EN)](/en/responsible-gambling): Responsible gambling resources.
- [Responsible Gambling (ES)](/es/responsible-gambling): Juego responsable.
